title: GPT-6 Astra: Early Hands-On Review #future #tech #ai
description:
See how GPT-6 Astra handles complex tasks by taking direct control of your computer applications.

This demonstration explores how the latest model interacts with software like Roblox Studio and Blender, achieving near-perfect performance. We look at the implications for long-term AI productivity and how autonomous agents are changing the way we navigate browser-based workflows.

Subscribe for more AI tool breakdowns and comment below if you want to see specific app integrations tested next.
